title: lib.rs doc: SHA-512 is RSA-only; ECDSA SHA-512 (P-521) is unsupported
description: smime-tree/src/lib.rs line 42: '//\!   Sign/verify: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 (SHA-256/384/512), ECDSA P-256 (SHA-256), P-384 (SHA-384).' The SHA-512 entry applies only to RSA (sha512WithRSAEncryption), but the comma placement makes it look like it applies to ECDSA too. P-521/SHA-512 is explicitly rejected by signature_algorithm_oid() with UnsupportedAlgorithm. A reader skimming the docs could attempt to use a P-521 cert with SHA-512 expecting it to work. Suggested rewrite: 'RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 with SHA-256/384/512, ECDSA P-256 (SHA-256 only), P-384 (SHA-384 only). P-521 is not supported.'
